```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(lubridate)
library(hms)
library(readr)
```

#Read in and collate all the files in the DOC Processed Data folder 
```{r}

files <- list.files(path = "Processed_Data", pattern = "DOC.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)

data1 <- read_csv(files[1], id = "filename", col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
colnames(data1)
data1 <- data1 %>% 
  mutate(Date = mdy(Date))

data2 <- read_csv(files[2], id = "filename", col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
colnames(data2)
data2 <- data2 %>% 
  mutate(Date = mdy(Date))

data3 <- read_csv(files[3], id = "filename", col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
colnames(data3)
data3_formatted <- data3 %>% 
  mutate(Replicate = Sample_ID, 
         Sample_ID = sample_name, 
         Date = ymd(Sample_Date)) %>% 
  mutate(
  Time_Local = 
    ifelse(is.na(Time), NA,
    paste0(
      substr(sprintf("%04d", as.numeric(Time)), 1, 2),
      ":",
      substr(sprintf("%04d", as.numeric(Time)), 3, 4)))) %>% 
  select(-sample_name, -Time) #%>% 
  mutate(across(everything(), as.character))

# data_list <- lapply(files, function(f) {
#   df <- read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, colClasses = "character")  # avoids factors
#   return(df)
# })

# Combine all files
DOC_data <- bind_rows(data1, data2, data3_formatted)

colnames(DOC_data)

DOC_data1 <- DOC_data %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(Sample_ID, "Pair")) %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(Sample_ID, "isco")) %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(Sample_ID, "INCUB")) %>% 
  rename(Sample_Location = Site) %>% 
  mutate(Sample_Location = ifelse(str_detect(Sample_ID, "GCW"), "Flume", Sample_Location)) %>% 
  mutate(Sample_ID = gsub("ESTUARY", "EST", Sample_ID)) %>% 
  mutate(Replicate = gsub("ESTUARY", "EST", Replicate)) %>% 
  select(Project, Sample_ID, Date, Time_Local, Sample_Location, Sample_Type, Replicate, npoc_mgL, npoc_uM, npoc_flag, tdn_mgL, tdn_uM, tdn_flag)

```

#Read in and collate all the files in the DIC Processed Data folder 
```{r}

files <- list.files(path = "Processed_Data", pattern = "DIC.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)

data1 <- read_csv(files[1], id = "filename", col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
colnames(data1)
data1 <- data1 %>% 
  mutate(Date = mdy(Date))

data2 <- read_csv(files[2], id = "filename", col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
colnames(data2)
data2 <- data2 %>% 
  mutate(Date = mdy(Date))

data3 <- read_csv(files[3], id = "filename", col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
colnames(data3)
data3_formatted <- data3 %>% 
  mutate(Replicate = Sample_ID, 
         Sample_ID = sample_name, 
         Date = ymd(Sample_Date)) %>% 
  mutate(
  Time_Local = 
    ifelse(is.na(Time), NA,
    paste0(
      substr(sprintf("%04d", as.numeric(Time)), 1, 2),
      ":",
      substr(sprintf("%04d", as.numeric(Time)), 3, 4)))) %>% 
  select(-sample_name, -Time) 

# Combine all files
DIC_data <- bind_rows(data1, data2, data3_formatted)
colnames(DIC_data)

DIC_data1 <- DIC_data %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(Sample_ID, "Pair")) %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(Sample_ID, "isco")) %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(Sample_ID, "INCUB")) %>% 
  rename(Sample_Location = Site) %>% 
  mutate(Sample_Location = ifelse(str_detect(Sample_ID, "GCW"), "Flume", Sample_Location)) %>% 
  select(Project, Sample_ID, Date, Time_Local, Sample_Location, Sample_Type, Replicate, ic_mgL, ic_uM, ic_flag)

```

##Combine dataframes
```{r combine bottle data}

DIC_DOC <- merge(DIC_data1, DOC_data1, by = c("Project", "Date", "Time_Local", "Sample_Location", "Sample_ID", "Sample_Type", "Replicate"), all = TRUE)
  mutate(
    Replicate = case_when(
      Sample_ID == "LatT_GCW_EST_20240718_1046" ~ "EST4", 
      Sample_ID == "LatT_GCW_EST_20240718_1521" ~ "EST5", 
      TRUE ~ Replicate
    )
  ) %<% 
```


#Read in and collate all the files in the TA Processed Data folder 
```{r}

files <- list.files(path = "Processed_Data", pattern = "TA.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
files

data1 <- read_csv(files[1], id = "filename", col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
colnames(data1)

data1_formattted <- data1 %>% 
  mutate(Sample_Location = ifelse(site == "GCW"), )



data_list <- lapply(files, function(f) {
  df <- read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)  # avoids factors
  # df$Site <- as.character(df$Site)             # ensures character
  return(df)
})

# Combine all files
TA_data <- bind_rows(data_list)

#remove the first unneeded column
TA_data <- TA_data[, -which(names(TA_data) == "X")]

##Match DIC/DOC columns names
TA_data1 <- TA_data %>% 
  mutate(Project = "FATE", 
         TA_mmolL = Alk_GP_avg/1000, 
         Date = mdy(date), 
         Time = substr(time, 1, 5), 
         location = gsub("Marsh_weir", "Flume", location)) %>% 
  rename(Sample_Location = location) %>% 
  select(Project, Date, Time, Sample_Location, sample_id, TA_mmolL)

```

##Combine dataframes
```{r combine bottle data}

DIC_DOC <- merge(DIC_data1, DOC_data1, by = c("Project", "Date", "Time", "Sample_Location"), all = TRUE)
DIC_DOC_TA <- merge(DIC_DOC, TA_data1, by = c("Project", "Date", "Time", "Sample_Location"), all = TRUE)
DIC_DOC_TA <- DIC_DOC_TA %>% 
  rename(Time_Local = Time)

```

##Merge with metadata
```{r metadata}

meta_2025 <- read.csv("Metadata/FATE_Monitoring_Metadata_2025.csv", colClasses = "character")
meta_2026 <- read.csv("Metadata/FATE_Monitoring_Metadata_2026.csv", colClasses = "character")

meta <- bind_rows(meta_2025, meta_2026)

meta1 <- meta %>% 
  mutate(Date = mdy(Date)) %>% 
  select(-c(DIC_24ml, DIC_ex_1ml, SO4.H2S_5ml, Nutr_10ml, DOC_20ml, TA_250ml))

all_data <- DIC_DOC_TA %>% 
  left_join(meta1, by = c("Date", "Time_Local", "Sample_Location"))

```



## Write the 2023 file out to the folder 
```{r, echo=FALSE}

#write out all the lysimeter sample data 
write.csv(all_data, "FATE_DOC_DIC_TA.csv")

```
